findings.title: Listed third-party SDK bundled without its own privacy manifest — Alamofire
findings.message: Alamofire is on Apple's list of third-party SDKs that require a privacy manifest, but this copy has none.
fix: Update the SDK to a version that ships its own PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy
If you add it as a binary dependency, make sure that version is signed (Apple also requires a valid signature, which this tool doesn't check)
Contact the SDK vendor if no version ships a privacy manifest yet

sources.title: Apple — Reminder: Privacy requirement for app submissions starts May 1
